purpose: Teach: せり/右下/団員/シャフト/本拠地/在り/ハイライト/ロケーション

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、市場で、本気で、絶対、せり、絶対、お父さん、絶対、参加してきたって
lines.en: Mom, Dad went to the market auction. He was really serious about it.
lines.style: Bright, eager curiosity. Rushes slightly on the details. Wants Mom to confirm he understood something important. Small upward lift at the end.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。テストの、本気で、絶対、解答用紙、絶対、右下に、絶対、名前、絶対、書くのよ、翔くん
lines.en: Yes, honey. And when you take your test, you need to write your name on the bottom-right of the answer sheet. Really carefully, Sho.
lines.style: Gentle redirecting, like she's nodding but also gently steering his attention. Warm and clear. Slightly slower on the instructions—she wants him to actually remember this.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、地域の、絶対、団員、絶対、頑張ってるんだよ、ママ
lines.en: Dad really works hard for the community group, Mom. He does.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Small but steady. He's defending something he's noticed—not bragging, just stating what he knows to be true. Almost to himself.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、本気で、絶対、シャフトを、絶対、加工する仕事、絶対、していたって、聞いたわよ、翔くん
lines.en: Grandpa used to do such important work when he was young—shaft processing, you know. Your mother told me all about it, Sho.
lines.style: Nostalgic and warm, touching something tender. Speaks as if sharing a small gift. Pace is unhurried. She's connecting Sho to something that matters.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お父さんの会社、本気で、絶対、本拠地、絶対、東京なんだよね、ママ
lines.en: Dad's company is based in Tokyo, Mom. That's where it all is.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact statement, but with a thread of wonder underneath. He's learning how the world connects. Small and steady, checking his understanding.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃんの、本気で、絶対、在りし日の、絶対、お話、絶対、お母さんに、絶対、聞かせてもらったわ、翔くん
lines.en: Grandpa told your mother the most wonderful stories from when he was younger, you know. I was so happy to hear them.
lines.style: Soft, reflective warmth. She's in a memory. Lingers slightly on the tender moments. Speaks like she's carrying something precious and wants to pass it on.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 運動会の、本気で、絶対、ハイライト、絶対、ぼくの、絶対、リレー、絶対、だったよ、ママ
lines.en: The best part of the sports day was my relay race, Mom. I was really fast.
lines.style: Bright pride, but still genuine and small—not a boast, just a fact he's happy about. Slight smile in the voice. Natural, unhurried.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 家族旅行の、本気で、絶対、ロケーション、絶対、お父さん、絶対、決めてるって、翔くん、本気で、絶対、楽しみ
lines.en: Dad gets to pick where we go for our family trip, and I'm really excited about it. I can't wait to see where he chooses.
lines.style: Warm anticipation bubbling just under the surface. Trusting, eager. The voice of a child who knows his father will choose something good. Slight lift at the end.
